weeks.shortDescription: With performances that have been dazzling dance floors, Inner Forest has been the standOut performance at multiple festivals that many of us have been awed by in recent years.
weeks.bio: Inner Forest is an Oregon-based musician, DJ, and producer weaving ancient sound wisdom into forward-thinking electronic music.Inner Forest has performed alongside artists such as Beats Antique, CloZee, Desert Dwellers, Tipper, David Starfire, David Satori, Zoe Jakes, ill.Gates, Lafa Taylor, Nico Luminous, ill-esha, Trevor Kelly, Knowa Lusion, and The Human Experience. His music appears on High Vibe Records and Merkaba Music
weeks.name: DJ Inner Forest
weeks.setDescription:
Drawing from global traditions and bass-driven experimentation, his work blurs the line between ceremony and dancefloor, offering immersive journeys that awaken the body, mind, and spirit. 
Each composition is crafted with intention, layering organic instrumentation, hypnotic rhythms, and visionary textures to guide listeners into altered states of connection and bliss.
weeks.somaticBlurb: Explore the ooey-gooey space where therapeutic acro meets contact improv with one of our greatest bodyBoss experts leads. We’ll begin with a grounding partner thai massage warm-up to drop in and connect. From there, we’ll stay close to the floor, learning to roll, melt, and transition in and out of acro yoga shapes. We’ll weave these movements into contact improv, exploring how acro poses can emerge naturally within a shared dance. Come ready to slow down, get playful, and discover new ways of moving together.

weeks.shortDescription: Dawn believes that dance is a powerful conduit to joy, and a prayer in motion that allows you to shed the weight of the world and dance your way into ecstatic connection with the Divine. Let the beat guide you, the melody envelop you, and the dance set your spirit free.
weeks.bio: Dawn describes her style as “World Beats & Power Ballads,” and creates transformative journeys through deep tribal rhythms interwoven with the soaring vocals and melodies, mixed with a little funk. She loves creating sonic landscapes that sync you to the primal pulse of the Earth, and get you tapped in to the collective heartbeat of everyone else on the dancefloor.
